name: Single-leg glute bridge
definition: Lie on the back with one foot planted and the other leg held off the floor. Lift and lower the pelvis using the planted leg while maintaining the selected free-leg position.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Lie on the back with one foot planted and the other leg held off the floor.
value.movement: Lift and lower the pelvis using the planted leg while maintaining the selected free-leg position.
value.finish: Return the pelvis to the floor before repeating on the same side.
value.range_of_motion: Repeatable pelvic lift with the free foot remaining unsupported.
